nodes.description: Privileged owner address; gates delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of holder balances, updated with raw unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping of spender allowances.
Per-address sale counter checked against _saleNum and incremented on each transferFrom.
Whitelist mapping that bypasses sale restrictions in ensure().
Minimum sale amount threshold set by init().
Maximum sale amount threshold set by init().
Global sale count limit set by init().
Whitelisted trading address settable only by owner.
Total token supply fixed in the constructor.
Payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core transfer routine: allowance check, ensure() gate, unchecked balance mutations and sale counter increment.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Whitelist gate allowing owner, UNI pair/trade addresses and canSale entries, otherwise defers to condition().
Enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits for non-whitelisted senders.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address.
Owner-only initialization of sale parameters.
Owner-only loop distributing tokens with unchecked multiplication and division.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Deploys token, mints supply to msg.sender, sets owner and unlimited UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance accounting and balance credits.
Low-level delegatecall to a caller-supplied address inside delegate().
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked _value * _tos.length, balance subtraction and _value/2 division.
Deterministic Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure().
Low-level .call(data) to a token address in SafeERC20 with optional return data decoding.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used in allowance and balance arithmetic.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend.
Per-recipient amount in batchSend.
Delegatecall target address in delegate().
Delegatecall calldata in delegate().
Loop index in batchSend.
Computed total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
New trade address parameter.
Sale count parameter of init.
Minimum sale token parameter of init.
Maximum sale token parameter of init.

edges.reason: transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transfer delegates the state change to transferFrom.
transferFrom compares msg.sender against _from to decide whether an allowance must be spent.
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value).
ensure falls back to condition(_from, _value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
pairFor returns _UNI which ensure compares against _from.
ensure whitelists transfers where _from or _to equals owner.
ensure whitelists transfers where canSale[_from] is true.
ensure whitelists transfers where _from equals tradeAddress.
condition reads _saleNum to gate sales.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf for sender and recipient.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
transferFrom performs raw unchecked balance subtraction and addition.
Attacker-controlled _value flows into the unchecked balance arithmetic.
The unchecked arithmetic writes the balanceOf mapping.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve keys the allowance entry by msg.sender.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
delegate performs a delegatecall to an arbitrary address, giving it full control of contract storage and context.
The caller-selected address a is the delegatecall target.
The supplied calldata b is forwarded into the delegatecall.
An arbitrary delegatecall target can re-enter transferFrom while balances and sale counters are being updated.
init requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale parameters.
saleNum sets the _saleNum state variable.
token sets the _minSale state variable.
maxToken sets the _maxSale state variable.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass-transferring balances.
_tos.length feeds the unchecked total computation.
_value feeds unchecked multiplication and _value/2 division.
batchSend executes unchecked arithmetic on user-provided values.
Total amount is computed without overflow protection.
The loop index drives repeated unchecked balance writes.
The batch loop writes balanceOf for msg.sender and each recipient.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before writing tradeAddress.
addr is stored into the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the full supply to the deployer.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied supply.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
The constructor grants the UNI router an unlimited allowance.
_value drives the transfer amount and the early zero-amount return.
_from is the debited account in transferFrom.
_to is the credited account in transferFrom.
SafeERC20 makes a low-level call to an external token, whose fallback logic executes before checks complete.

Parameter is only meaningful as the credited account of transferFrom.
Amount parameter flows directly into transferFrom allowance and balance arithmetic.
Recipient array exists only to parameterize the batchSend loop.
Per-recipient amount exists only to parameterize batchSend arithmetic.
Target address exists only to parameterize the delegatecall in delegate.
Calldata exists only to parameterize the delegatecall in delegate.
Loop counter is local bookkeeping of batchSend.
Computed total is local bookkeeping of the batchSend arithmetic.
Argument only serves to set tradeAddress through the owner-only setter.
Argument only serves to initialize _saleNum through init.
Argument only serves to initialize _minSale through init.
Argument only serves to initialize _maxSale through init.
